info.title: SummitSync
info.description:
Bearer-token API for the SummitSync mobile apps. It exposes the same groups, events, chat, checklist and poll features as the website, enforced by the same server-side policies.

## Authentication
1. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (or `/auth/register`) with a `device_name` returns a token.
2. Send it on every request as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A token expires after 90 days without use (every request renews it); an expired or revoked token answers 401, so sign in again.
3. Accounts with two-factor authentication get `{"two_factor": true, "challenge_token": "..."}` first; finish with `POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor-challenge`.
4. Everything except `/me`, `/auth/*` and `/meta` needs a verified email address (otherwise 403).

## Conventions
- Always send `Accept: application/json`; errors are JSON (401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not found or hidden, 422 validation, 429 rate limited).
- `Accept-Language` (`en`, `hu`, `ro`) selects the language of server messages and activity names. A signed-in user's saved locale wins.
- Resources that depend on the viewer carry a `can` object. Render from it; never re-implement permission logic in the app.
- Polls marked `is_anonymous` never reveal who voted for what, to anyone. The checklist only exposes aggregates to participants.
- Chat sends accept an optional `client_id` (a UUID you generate). Retrying with the same id never posts twice, so an offline queue can replay safely.
- Live chat arrives on the private Reverb channel `event.{id}` (authorize through `/broadcasting/auth` with the bearer token).

post.summary: Join the group the invitation belongs to. Unusable invitations answer 422

get.summary:
Look up an invitation from a link (`/invitations/{token}`). `status` is `valid` or the reason it cannot be used
(`revoked`, `expired`, `exhausted`, `email_mismatch`); unusable invitations reveal nothing about the group

post.summary: Make a participant an assistant organizer

delete.summary: Take assistant rights away from a participant

post.summary:
Authorize a private Reverb/Pusher channel subscription (`socket_id`, `channel_name` such as `private-event.12`)
with the bearer token. Point the realtime client's `authEndpoint` here; the website uses the session-based
`/broadcasting/auth` instead
Block a user you share a group with. Only people from your own groups can be blocked, so ids cannot be probed

delete.summary: Unblock a user. Unblocking someone you never blocked is a no-op

post.summary:
Ask to change the email (`email`, `current_password`). A confirmation link is mailed to the new address and the
change applies once it is opened; until then `pending_email` shows the request. Not available for accounts with
a linked Google/Facebook login (`can_change_email` is false)
Cast or change your vote (`option_id`)
Close a poll early (event organizers)
Finish two-factor setup with a 6-digit `code` from the authenticator app
Upload a profile photo (`avatar`, multipart; jpg, png or webp, at least 64 px, at most 5 MB). It is cropped square and re-encoded

delete.summary: Delete a chat message (chat moderators: event organizers and group admins)
Remove the group logo (group admins only)

post.summary: Upload a group logo (`logo`, multipart; group admins only; jpg, png or webp, at most 5 MB). It is fitted inside 512 px and re-encoded

delete.summary: Delete the account (required in-app by the app stores). Needs the current `password` unless the account has none

get.summary: The signed-in user. Also the way to poll whether the email has been verified yet

patch.summary: Update `name`, `username` and `locale`. The email changes through `POST /me/email` (confirmed by link)

delete.summary: Turn two-factor authentication off (`current_password`), also cancelling an unfinished setup

get.summary:
The users you have blocked. Their chat messages are left out of history; clients must also hide
their live messages (the realtime channel is shared by everyone in the event)
Aggregates only (my_checked, checked_count, total_participants): never named per-user data

post.summary: Add a checklist item (event organizers)

get.summary: Named per-person completion: event organizers and group admins only, fetched on demand

checked_item_ids.description: In the order of the checklist, so the client can read them off item by item.

get.summary: Newest-first pages keyed by message id; clients prepend older pages as the user scrolls up. Messages from users you blocked are left out

post.summary:
Send a chat message. It is also broadcast live on the private `event.{id}` Reverb channel. Send a
`client_id` (a UUID you generate) to make retries safe: the same id returns the original message with 200
instead of posting again, so an offline queue can replay without duplicates. The id comes back on the message
and in the broadcast, so the sender can match its own echo

get.summary: Who is attending, in joining order. `role` is only filled in for event organizers

A group's events (active group members only). `scope=upcoming` (default) lists events that have not ended;
`scope=past` is the archive, newest first, sized with `limit` (default 12, max 120)

post.summary: Create an event in a group; the creator becomes its admin

get.summary: Open invitations with their share links (group admins only; tokens are secrets)

post.summary: Create an invitation link (group admins only), optionally bound to an email, with an expiry and a use limit

get.summary: Active members (active group members only)
Browse or search groups (12 per page). `q` searches by relevance, `activities[]` filters by activity key (max 4)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Paginated listings read the page number themselves; declared so the API spec documents it.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Create a group; the creator becomes its admin

get.summary: The groups the signed-in user is an active member of, alphabetically
All polls of the event. Voter identities are only included for non-anonymous polls whose results the viewer may see; anonymous polls never include them

post.summary: Create a poll (event organizers). `is_anonymous` is fixed at creation

get.summary:
Search groups, events and people at once with `q` (and optionally `activities[]`). Events and people are
limited to the viewer's own groups

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Paginated listings read the page number themselves; declared so the API spec documents it.

post.summary: Join an event (active members of its group)
Join a public group

post.description:
Accounts with two-factor authentication answer `{"two_factor": true, "challenge_token": "..."}` instead of a
token; finish with `POST /auth/two-factor-challenge`.
post.summary: Sign in with email and password and receive an API token
Revoke the token used for this request (sign out of this device only)

Replace all recovery codes with eight new ones (`current_password`). The old codes stop working. Codes are
shown only here and at setup, so the app should make the user save them

post.description:
A verification email is sent. Until it is confirmed only `/me` and the verification-resend endpoint work;
everything else answers 403.
post.summary: Create an account (`name`, `username`, `email`, `password`, `password_confirmation`) and receive an API token

put.summary: Set the order of the checklist items (event organizers)

post.summary: Report a chat message to the platform moderators. Reporting the same message twice is harmless
Send the email verification link again

get.summary: Search places by name for the event location picker (optionally biased towards `lat`/`lon`)

An event page: details, the viewer's membership and `can` (what they may do). Event content such as chat,
checklist and polls needs `can.view`

patch.summary: Edit an event (event admins and assistants)

get.summary: A group page. Public groups show basic info to everyone; membership-only content has its own endpoints
Reference data the app needs before sign-in: the curated activity list, supported languages and feature flags

How many suggestions each checklist item has (item id => count), so the list can show the shopping bag
only where there is something to show. One request for the whole list; counts are cached briefly per
label because several events carry the same items
Shopping suggestions for one checklist item, for everyone who may see the event's checklist

put.summary: Check or uncheck an item for the signed-in participant (`is_checked`). Returns the updated aggregates

post.summary: Finish a two-factor sign-in with an authenticator code or a recovery code

put.summary: Save the account's language (`en`, `hu`, `ro`); it then wins over `Accept-Language` and picks the language of emails

Change the password (`current_password`, `password`, `password_confirmation`). Accounts that only used
Google/Facebook so far have no current password and set their first one. Every other signed-in device is
signed out; the token used for this request stays valid

token.description: Shown once: the server only stores a hash. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

starts_at_local.description: Wall-clock values in the event's own timezone, for datetime-local inputs.

PasswordConfirmedRequest.description:
Stateless stand-in for the website's "confirm your password" step: sensitive security changes carry the
current password in the request. Accounts without a password (Google/Facebook only) must set one first.
PasswordConfirmedRequest.title: PasswordConfirmedRequest

current_password.description: A social-only account has no current password to prove; it is choosing its first one.

PollVisibility.description:
| | |---| | `always`
Results are visible to every participant at any time. | | `after_vote`
Results appear once the participant has voted. | | `after_close`
Results appear only when the poll is closed. |
PollVisibility.title: PollVisibility

RegisterRequest.description: The account fields themselves are validated by Fortify's CreateNewUser action, the same one the website uses.
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key: resending the same one returns the original message instead of a duplicate.

avatar.description: `image` already excludes SVG; the file is re-encoded on top of this check.

logo.description: `image` already excludes SVG; the file is re-encoded on top of this check.

pending_email.description: An email change waiting for its confirmation link, else null.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
